#### Reading a digit pixel by pixel

`make_reader(nn.RNN, 1)` reads each digit one pixel at a time,
in 64 steps.
Train it for 20 [epochs](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-epoch) with `train()`.
What fraction of the test digits does it classify correctly?
